**Job Description**

Job Purpose :

Data Platform Services is building a modern, governed, metadata-driven business data fabric powered by SAP Datasphere and the broader SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) / SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) ecosystem. This platform spans cross-system ingestion, semantic data layering, long-term persistence/archiving, and governed consumption across multiple downstream analytical and operational engines.

We are seeking a DataOps Engineer who treats spaces, data pipelines, replication flows, and semantic models as configuration, not one-off manual builds — someone who has designed or maintained environments where central metadata and rule tables drive how data assets are onboarded, transformed, partitioned, secured, and federated, rather than hand-crafting individual spaces and views from scratch.

You will operate across the full data lifecycle: hybrid ingestion/replication (landing persisted business layer cold store/archive), lifecycle and storage tiering strategies, and the dynamic routing engine that provides filtered, masked, and context-rich semantic views to multiple downstream consumers.

Key Responsibilities..

* Build and operate resilient real-time and batch ingestion pipelines within SAP Datasphere using Replication Flows, Data Flows, and Transformation Flows from SAP (S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, SAP BDC) and non-SAP cloud/lake sources.
* Design and maintain metadata-driven Space and Pipeline generation — where onboarding a new source entity, defining business semantics, or establishing delta replication is driven by configuration registries, templates, and CLI/API automation rather than manual UI workflows.
* Implement retention and data tiering strategies using Datasphere cold storage integration, partition-based retention, and hybrid connectivity to external cloud object stores (e.g., ADLS Gen2, AWS S3, Snowflake).
* Build and maintain a governed routing & semantic distribution engine: leverage a metadata rules registry (splittable, target\_consumers[], row\_filter\_expr, column\_mask\_expr) to programmatically build and manage Data Access Controls (DAC), Analytic Models, and Consumption Views across Spaces.
* Own Datasphere & BDC platform governance: architect Space hierarchies, user privileges, Space-to-Space sharing topologies, catalog registrations, and cross-system business context lineages.
* Drive DataOps & CI/CD automation: manage automated asset lifecycle and deployment across environments (Dev/Test/Prod) leveraging Datasphere CLI, Content Network packages, REST APIs, and Git-integrated repositories.
* Monitor platform health & replication telemetry: track replication lag, task execution logs, memory/storage consumption quotas across Spaces, and semantic view performance; build proactive alerting for SLA breaches and data drift.
* Collaborate with SAP functional/data modeling teams to align on semantic consistency (CDS views, business context, ODP extractors) and translate consumer access requirements into secure, performant consumption models.
* Document architecture, data flow patterns, and security topologies to maintain enterprise compliance and accelerate developer onboarding.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Platform & SAP Datasphere / BDC

* Hands-on experience with SAP Datasphere (formerly Data Warehouse Cloud) and/or SAP BDC / BTP Data Services.
* Strong hands-on expertise with Datasphere core artifacts: Spaces, Connections (DP Agent, Cloud Connectors), Replication Flows, Data Flows, Transformation Flows, View Modeling (Graphical & SQL/Script), and Analytic Models.
* Deep understanding of SAP source integration patterns: CDS Views, ODP/Extractors, SAP Landscape Transformation (SLT), S/4HANA integrations, and federation vs. replication trade-offs.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and SAP HANA Cloud engine concepts (calculation views, indexing, execution plan analysis, in-memory optimization).

Metadata-Driven Engineering & Automation (Critical)

* Proven experience building or maintaining metadata/config-driven integration frameworks — where schemas, replication tasks, or security policies are programmatically driven by configuration tables or parameterized templates.
* Experience with SAP Datasphere Command Line Interface (datasphere CLI), REST APIs, or Python scripts to automate tenant management, Space provisioning, CSN/JSON definition generation, and user onboarding.
* Strong understanding of keeping semantic models and DAC rules synchronized with an authoritative source-of-truth metadata repository.

Platform Engineering / DataOps

* CI/CD & Lifecycle Management: Hands-on experience with Datasphere Content Network, transport management, and version-controlled deployment pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI).
* Scripting & Orchestration: Strong scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and experience with enterprise orchestrators (Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Control-M, or SAP BTP job scheduling).
* Observability & Performance Tuning: Experience monitoring space storage quotas, replication queues, performance optimization of complex joined views, and setting up automated incident alerts.

Governance & Security

* Deep expertise in Datasphere Data Access Controls (DAC), object-level authorizations, row-level filters, and column-level masking for sensitive/PII data.
* Familiarity with enterprise cataloging and metadata lineage (SAP Datasphere Catalog, SAP Purview connector, Collibra, or Alation).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical data engineering and business analytics teams.

Nice to Have

* Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) integration and Live Connection optimization.
* Experience with SAP HANA Cloud / HDI Containers and native HANA database artifacts.
* Hands-on knowledge of cloud lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Fabric) connected via Open Data Mesh / Federation to Datasphere.
* Familiarity with SAP BTP global account and subaccount administration, Cloud Identity Services (IAS), and single sign-on (SSO).

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

* Config-Driven Asset Deployment: New entity ingestion and Space provisioning are automated via configuration tables and CLI scripts, minimizing manual UI modeling.
* Automated Security & Access: Data Access Control (DAC) generation and Space-sharing policies operate seamlessly based on centralized security metadata.
* Optimized Storage & Replication: Automated data tiering, delta replication monitoring, and partition pruning are established and operating reliably across production spaces.
* End-to-End DataOps Pipeline: CI/CD deployment routines across Dev/Test/Prod environments are fully automated with zero manual transport bottlenecks.

**Qualifications**

**Certifications**

Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) - Workforce Academy OnlineWorkforce Academy Online

**Required Skills**

Agile Methodology, Agile Methodology, Applications Support, Ariba, Banking Capital Markets, Cash Counting, Change Management, Client Relations, Collaboration Tools, Design Thinking, Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Executive Presence, Financial Operations, Hedge Funds, Human Resources (HR), Inclusion, Investment Accounts, Modernizing Operations, People Leadership, Personal Effectiveness, Project Systems, Risk Management, Sales And Distribution Vistex, SAP Advanced Planning and Optimization (SAP APO), SAP Analytics Cloud {+ 27 more}

title: People Support Specialist
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Team**

Join our People Operations team, the central hub that powers our company's HR systems and processes. As a People Support Specialist, you will be a crucial member of the team ensuring a seamless and efficient Workday experience for all employees and managers. We are a highly collaborative group that partners with every function in Human Resources—from Recruiting and Talent Experience to Total Rewards and Global Mobility—to support our global workforce.

**About the Role**

This role is focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement of our core HR systems. You will be a subject matter expert, responsible for maintaining the integrity and performance of our HR processes. Your key responsibilities will include:

  

* **System Support & Escalation:** Serve as the primary contact for Tier 2 Workday escalations, troubleshooting complex issues and providing timely, effective solutions to our stakeholders.
* **Testing & Change Management:** Coordinate and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements, new configurations, and major Workday releases to ensure they function flawlessly.
* **Process Improvement:** Manage key operational processes and enhance our employee self-service (Tier 0) resources, always looking for ways to improve efficiency and the user experience.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with HR Partners and Centers of Excellence (COEs) to understand their needs, gather feedback, and ensure our systems are aligned with business objectives.
* **Data Management:** Take ownership of data integrity by managing processes like Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) data loads with precision.

**About You**

  

We are looking for a proactive problem-solver with a strong technical aptitude and a passion for creating great employee experiences.

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* **6+ years of experience** in HR Operations, HRIS, or a related field, with hands-on experience in Workday modules such as HCM, Recruiting, and Compensation.
* Proven ability to test system enhancements, troubleshoot issues independently, and learn complex processes quickly.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong customer-service orientation with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Aptitude for and willingness to work with modern AI tools to enhance HR processes.  

**Other Qualifications:**

  

* Project management experience will be preferred
* Professional fluency in a second language such as **German, French, Spanish, or Italian** would be an added advantage

  
  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

  

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.

  

Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.

  

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible.

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**

At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

At Smiths we apply leading\-edge technology to design, manufacture and deliver smarter engineering solutions for mission\-critical applications, solving some of the world's toughest problems for our customers, our communities and our world. We are a FTSE100, global business of around 15,000 colleagues, based in 50 countries.


Our solutions have a real impact on lives across the planet, enabling industry, improving healthcare, enhancing security, advancing connectivity, and supporting new homes. Our products and services are often critical to our customers’ operations, while our proprietary technology and high service levels help create competitive advantage. We welcome colleagues with a curious mind, who are happy with responsibility, enjoy a challenge and are attracted by the idea of working at a business with an almost 170\-year history of innovation, and four global divisions, all experts in their field.

 **Job Description** **Job Purpose:** As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a key role in maintaining and enhancing the technology services that support Smiths' global operations. Working across infrastructure, networking and cloud technologies, you will help deliver reliable, secure and modern services for colleagues worldwide while contributing to technology improvement and transformation initiatives.


We are looking for a proactive individual who takes ownership, takes pride in delivering excellent service, and is motivated to identify opportunities to improve the user experience, resolve problems and help colleagues succeed.

**Responsibilities:**

* Proactively ensure high levels of systems and infrastructure availability
* Troubleshoot end\-to\-end solutions spanning multiple operating systems, cloud platforms and networking technologies
* Support and administer Microsoft operating systems, Hyper\-V, Active Directory, Entra ID, Azure and Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI)
* Install, configure, test and maintain operating systems, application software, backup solutions and system management tools
* Support the management and optimisation of LAN and wireless infrastructure (Cisco / Meraki)
* Diagnose and resolve LAN and wireless networking issues
* Identify opportunities to improve network and wireless performance
* Assist with operational ticket management, incident resolution and service improvements
* Support the implementation and adoption of Smiths BIS standards
* Collaborate with colleagues across infrastructure, cloud, networking and service teams to deliver effective technology solutions

**Planning and Decision Making:**

* Identify opportunities to enhance infrastructure services, processes and user experience
* Anticipate potential issues and take preventative action where possible
* Prioritise activities and issues effectively within a complex global environment
* Contribute ideas and recommendations that support continuous improvement and operational excellence
* Work collaboratively with internal teams and external partners to resolve problems and shape future technology direction

**Impact and Scope:**

* Global scope supporting all Smiths divisions and business functions
* Contribute to the delivery of secure, reliable and high\-performing technology services used by colleagues worldwide
* Support infrastructure services that enable business operations, productivity and growth across the organisation

**Key Internal and External Relationships:**

* Demonstrate and promote Smiths Core Values: Customer Focus, Ownership, Integrity, Safety and Respect
* Build strong working relationships with Infrastructure Management, Service Management, Business Partnering and Infrastructure teams
* Collaborate with colleagues across technology functions to deliver reliable and effective services
* Maintain productive relationships with strategic vendors including AT\&T and other third\-party technology partners

  

**Qualifications** **Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Experience supporting Wintel infrastructure, including Windows Server administration, patching and troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of Active Directory services, including Group Policy, DNS, DHCP and identity management
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, identity lifecycle management and hybrid identity solutions
* Experience or exposure to Azure Local (HCI) environments and their integration with on\-premises and cloud infrastructure
* Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and performance issues within a remote support environment
* Understanding of networking fundamentals; CCNA certification or equivalent practical experience is advantageous
* Knowledge of Cisco LAN, Cisco Wireless, Cisco Prime and Cisco ISE products and services would be beneficial
* Experience with tools such as SolarWinds, BMC Helix, BeyondTrust PRA or Guardicore is desirable
* Ability to collaborate effectively across networking, server, cloud and identity teams
* Knowledge of ITIL methodology; ITIL certification is advantageous
* A willingness to learn new technologies and continually develop technical expertise
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivering high\-quality outcomes
* Proactive approach to identifying, investigating and resolving issues
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a customer\-focused mindset

  

**Additional Information**  

We recognise that no candidate is likely to meet every requirement listed. If your experience and skills aligns with the behaviours we’re looking for and many of the skills and responsibilities outlined, we would encourage you to apply.


At Smiths, we value diverse perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work.

  

With colleagues stretching across the globe, we are proud of our diversity. To foster inclusivity, we run employee resource groups (ERGs) to provide a safe space for employees to connect and support each other. Our cross\-business ERGs include Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Women@Work Network, and Neurodiversity.


Across our company, we recognize excellence, culminating in the Smiths Excellence Awards, our annual celebration of the most extraordinary activities, people, and projects that best showcase our strengths and help drive our business forward. We announce these on our annual Smiths Day, a global celebration of Smiths around our network.
